mapper.select: SELECT t.tool_id AS owner_id, t.tool_code AS owner_code, t.tool_name AS owner_name, t.status AS owner_status, tv.version_no, tv.status AS version_status, mv.version_no AS referenced_version_no, (tv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version mv JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv ON tv.mcp_server_version_id = mv.mcp_server_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = tv.tool_id WHERE mv.mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} ORDER BY active DESC, t.tool_code, tv.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_mcp_server SET server_name = #{serverName}, description = #{description}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_mcp_server s SET status = #{status}, revision = s.revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE s.mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} AND s.revision = #{revision}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version mv JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv ON tv.mcp_server_version_id = mv.mcp_server_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = tv.tool_id WHERE mv.mcp_server_id = s.mcp_server_id AND tv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.status = 'ENABLED' )
UPDATE squad_chat.sq_mcp_server SET status = status WHERE mcp_server_id = #{mcpServerId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
